caseName: Clinger v. Chesapeake & Ohio Railway Co.
caseNameFull: Eliza B. Clinger, Administratrix, etc., in Error v. Chesapeake & Ohio Railway Company of Kentucky
summary: In error to the Court of Appeals of the State of Kentucky.
attorneys: Mr. Allan D. Cole for the plaintiff in error., Mr. E. L. Worthington for the defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction on the authority of Chesapeake & Ohio Railway Company v. McCabe, 213 U. S. 207.
